subscription_event_tier_change_check.value: "subscription_event"."kind" not in ('started', 'tier_changed') or ("subscription_event"."tier" is not null and "subscription_event"."effective_on" is not null)

subscription_payment_annual_check.name: subscription_payment_annual_check
subscription_payment_annual_check.value: ("subscription_payment"."purpose" = 'annual') = ("subscription_payment"."annual_first_month" is not null and "subscription_payment"."annual_last_month" is not null and "subscription_payment"."annual_discount_bps" is not null)

subscription_payment_succeeded_check.name: subscription_payment_succeeded_check
subscription_payment_succeeded_check.value: "subscription_payment"."status" not in ('succeeded', 'reversed') or "subscription_payment"."succeeded_at" is not null

onboarding_batch_money_check.name: onboarding_batch_money_check
onboarding_batch_money_check.value: "onboarding_batch"."kind" <> 'tenancies' or ("onboarding_batch"."approval_request_id" is null and "onboarding_batch"."posted_at" is null and "onboarding_batch"."status" not in ('awaiting_approval', 'posting', 'posted', 'rejected'))

onboarding_item_subject_check.name: onboarding_item_subject_check
onboarding_item_subject_check.value: ("onboarding_item"."kind" in ('agent_cash', 'rent_tax') and "onboarding_item"."owner_id" is not null and "onboarding_item"."lease_id" is null) or ("onboarding_item"."kind" not in ('agent_cash', 'rent_tax') and "onboarding_item"."lease_id" is not null)

data_protection_request_status_check.name: data_protection_request_status_check
data_protection_request_status_check.value: "data_protection_request"."status" in ('received', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'refused') and ("data_protection_request"."status" in ('completed', 'refused')) = ("data_protection_request"."completed_at" is not null)
